| [ADR-047](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-047.md) v4 | Promotion is audited in small persisted batches, ranked by expected yield, with decisions recorded apart from status changes | The owner's procedure of 2026-10-19 for finding entries whose evidence has outgrown their status. Candidates are triaged from metadata by a rubric that sets review order and never standing. They are reviewed five at a time, and each review ends in one of six dispositions with a specific blocker. Every step is persisted in record/promotion-audit/: a versioned queue.yaml with a hand-off block, one decision file per candidate, and one file per batch. A check keeps the queue and the decision files in step. Status changes go in separate pull requests of at most three entries. | [ADR-064](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-064.md) | Copies of published articles on course, faculty and scholarly third-party pages count as lawful copies to read | The first pass over the Deferred LITs on 2026-10-29 read two works from copies on university course or group pages, and turned down similar copies of ten others as being "of unknown provenance". The owner ruled the refusals mistaken. A copy of a published article on a university course or reading-list page, a faculty or research-group page, a scholarly third-party site, or an author's upload counts as a lawful copy to read.
